title: ShadowCutPlotKnowledgeGraph
description: Structured representation of a film script for continuity-aware AI supervision

scenes.description: All scenes indexed by scene number

props.description: All props indexed by canonical name (snake_case)

characters.description: All characters indexed by canonical name

setups.description: Narrative setups that require payoffs later

emotional_arcs.description: Emotional trajectory per character across the film

characters_present.description: Characters physically present in this scene

plot_weight.description: How much this scene matters to the overall narrative

critical_props.description: Props that MUST maintain continuity. Setup/payoff props, character-defining items, plot MacGuffins.

incidental_props.description: Background props with NO continuity requirement. Coffee cups, background furniture, etc.

emotional_tone.description: Required emotional atmosphere for this scene

lighting_notes.description: Lighting direction if specified in script

setups_introduced.description: Names of setups introduced in this scene

payoffs_delivered.description: Names of setups paid off in this scene

notes_for_shadow.description: Freeform notes the AI should be aware of for this scene

description.description: What the prop is and its narrative significance

plot_weight.description: CRITICAL = setup/payoff prop or character signature. IMPORTANT = supporting detail. INCIDENTAL = background.

continuity_rules.description: Specific rules this prop must follow across all scenes

state_vocabulary.description: Valid states this prop can be in (e.g., ['folded', 'open', 'burned'] for a letter)

payoff_scene.description: If this is a setup prop, which scene pays it off

setup_scene.description: If this is a payoff prop, which scene set it up

is_character_signature.description: True if this prop defines a character (e.g., father's watch, signature weapon)

is_macguffin.description: True if this prop drives the plot (e.g., the letter, the briefcase)

scene_state.description: Expected state of this prop in this specific scene

alert_on_change.description: If false, state changes are logged but not alerted (e.g., prop is SUPPOSED to change in this scene)

physically_present.description: True if physically visible; false if only referenced off-screen in dialogue

possession.description: Tracks prop transfers between characters within or across scenes

time_context.description: Time-of-day or temporal dependency for this prop's state in this scene

signature_props.description: Props always associated with this character

weight.description: How badly does the narrative break if this setup is forgotten?

description.description: What is established and what must be paid off

props_involved.description: Props that must maintain continuity for this setup to work

context.description: Brief narrative context for this beat
